Markets.title: US stocks: Retail buyers limit Nvidia stock rout
Markets.summary: Retail investors bought a record $111 million of Nvidia shares during the first half-hour of trading on Thursday. This dip-buying helped the stock recover from an opening loss of up to 14% to a decline of about 5%.

Markets.title: US Fed sets new meeting schedule for 2027, as foretold by Chairman Kevin Warsh
Markets.summary: The Federal Reserve will hold seven rate-setting meetings instead of eight in 2027, dedicating its October gathering to broader monetary policy. Chair Kevin Warsh also removed quarterly economic projection designations and moved the final meeting to November to review communication practices.

India.summary: Madras High Court Justice G R Swaminathan praised Prime Minister Narendra Modi's "Mann Ki Baat" radio broadcast in a November 11 court order. This remark was included in a division bench's ruling on a book scam case at the court's Madurai Bench.
